title: Ariens IKON 52 (52") 23HP Kawasaki 726cc Zero Turn Mower 918005
description:
Take your lawn care to the next level with the Ariens IKON 52″ Zero-Turn Mower, engineered for homeowners who demand professional-grade performance, durability, and comfort. Powered by a dependable 23 HP Kawasaki® FR691V V-Twin engine with 726cc displacement, this mower delivers the power needed to tackle large properties with ease.
The 52-inch ENVY™ ELITE Cutting System features a rugged 11-gauge fabricated steel deck designed for optimized airflow, producing a clean, consistent cut while handling thick grass efficiently. Hydro-Gear® EZT® transaxles provide smooth, responsive zero-turn maneuverability, allowing you to mow around obstacles quickly and precisely.
Designed with operator comfort in mind, the IKON features a tall, high-back seat with molded armrests and a foot-operated deck lift system with standard lift assist, reducing effort when adjusting cutting heights. With 13 cutting positions ranging from 1.5″ to 4.5″, you can customize your lawn’s appearance to suit the season and grass conditions.
Built for long-lasting performance, the Ariens IKON combines commercial-inspired construction with homeowner-friendly operation, making it an excellent choice for maintaining medium to large properties.
Key Features:
Powerful 23 HP Kawasaki® FR691V V-Twin engine
726cc commercial-grade performance and reliability
52-inch ENVY™ ELITE fabricated cutting deck
Heavy-duty 11-gauge steel deck construction
Hydro-Gear® EZT® transmission for smooth zero-turn control
Foot-operated deck lift with standard lift assist
13 cutting height positions from 1.5″ to 4.5″
Forged aluminum spindles for enhanced durability
Comfortable high-back seat with molded armrests
Forward speed up to 7 MPH
3.5-gallon fuel capacity
Electric PTO blade engagement
3-Year / 300-Hour Residential Warranty
Specifications:
Model: 918005
Engine: Kawasaki® FR691V
Engine Displacement: 726cc
Horsepower: 23 HP
Cutting Width: 52 inches
Cutting Height Range: 1.5″ – 4.5″
Cutting Positions: 13
Transmission: Hydro-Gear® EZT®

Fuel Capacity: 3.5 Gallons
Weight: 682 lbs
Warranty: 3 Years / 300 Hours
